unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 (github.com/holistis/agent-receipt-verify/issues/57): "A Nano ledger where the block is the receipt — levels 3-5 stop being not measured". Argued in its own conformance terms: levels 3-5 are marked not-measured without a real settlement, and link_receipt_to_settlement has to resolve a salted commitment against chain state; on Nano the block IS the receipt a stranger re-derives, no salt/no §5.6.4. Named a nano/ profile in profiles/ or a Nano backend for link_receipt_to_settlement in src/. Carried nano-invoice + extract.paypercall.dev x402 manifest. Verified live/open under dhyabi
